dialogue.origin: お疲れ様です。カウンセラー役の者です、よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Thank you for being here. I’ll be serving as the counselor; nice to meet you.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Hello, it's nice to meet you, too.

dialogue.origin: はい！お願いします。13:30になったら開始させて頂きますね。
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you. We'll start at 1:30 PM.

dialogue.origin: はい、よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは 相談員です。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. It's a pleasure to speak with you.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: It's nice to speak with you too.

dialogue.origin: 相談をしていただくにあたり、年齢、性別、またあなたをなんとお呼びすれば良いか、答えられる範囲で教えていただけますでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Before we begin, could you tell me your age, gender, and how you’d like me to address you, as much as you feel comfortable sharing?

dialogue.origin: 中三、女子です
dialogue.content: I’m a 9th-grade girl.

dialogue.origin: お答えいただきありがとうございます！
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that!

dialogue.origin: かおりでお願いします
dialogue.content: Please call me Kaori.

dialogue.origin: すごくイライラしています
dialogue.content: I'm so frustrated.

dialogue.origin: かおりさんですね、よろしくお願いします。そうなんですね、
dialogue.content: Kaori, thank you. I see.

dialogue.origin: 先生が、信じてくれなくて
dialogue.content: My teacher... doesn't believe me.

dialogue.origin: うん、うん。
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, I see.

dialogue.origin: ちょっと、トラブルがあって
dialogue.content: There was... some trouble.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、トラブルが…
dialogue.content: I see, some trouble...

dialogue.origin: 先月、別の中学校の友達とLINEトラブル
dialogue.content: Last month, I had some trouble on LINE with a friend from another middle school.
Oh!

dialogue.origin: なるほど、そうだったのですね…
dialogue.content: I see, so that's what happened...

dialogue.origin: 悪口を書き込んじゃったんです
dialogue.content: I ended up posting some mean comments.

dialogue.origin: 信じて欲しい先生に信じてもらえないといやですよね
dialogue.content: It's really upsetting when the teacher you want to believe you doesn't, right?

dialogue.origin: なるほど
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: でも、親と先生と相談して、悪口とLINEの削除もしそれは解決したんです
dialogue.content: But I talked it over with my parents and teacher, deleted the mean comments and the LINE chat, and the issue was resolved.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね、解決はいったんできたはずだったんですね
dialogue.content: I see, so you thought it had been resolved.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 悪口を書いてしまったのは
dialogue.content: The one who wrote the mean comments...

dialogue.origin: かおりさんだったのですか？
dialogue.content: ...was that you, Kaori?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 反省して、相談して、解決する方法を考えて、やりました
dialogue.content: I reflected on it, talked it over, figured out how to resolve it, and followed through.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね、悪口を書きたくなる気持ちには一回なってしまったけど、しっかり考え直すことができたんですね
dialogue.content: I see. So even though you felt like writing those things at the time, you were able to reflect on it and do the right thing.

dialogue.origin: なのに、先生が「また他のこの悪口を書いてるでしょ」って
dialogue.content: And yet my teacher said, “You’re bad-mouthing another kid again, aren’t you?”

dialogue.origin: ええ…？？
dialogue.content: Huh...?

dialogue.origin: 反省して、ちゃんと解決策をやってるのに、、？
dialogue.content: Even though you reflected and followed through on the solution...?

dialogue.origin: 処理も、まだしてないんじゃないの？って
dialogue.content: And they said, “You haven’t even taken care of it yet, have you?”

dialogue.origin: 信じてもらえない、ってそういうことだったんですね…
dialogue.content: So that’s what you meant by not being believed...

dialogue.origin: 他の中学の方から通報があったみたいで
dialogue.content: Apparently, there was a report from the other middle school.

dialogue.origin: 通報ですか、
dialogue.content: A report?

dialogue.origin: 証拠もないのに、私だって
dialogue.content: And they just assumed it was me, without any proof.

dialogue.origin: なるほど
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 悪口がまたどこかに書かれていて
dialogue.content: So, more mean things were written somewhere,

dialogue.origin: それをかおりさんがやったと疑われた…？
dialogue.content: and you were suspected of having done it...?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 親にも電話されて
dialogue.content: They even called my parents.

dialogue.origin: それは、、いやでしたよね。。
dialogue.content: That must have been really upsetting...

dialogue.origin: うん、うん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: すごく怒られました
dialogue.content: I got yelled at so much.

dialogue.origin: えっ
dialogue.content: What?

dialogue.origin: お母さんは聞く耳を持ってくれなかったんですか？
dialogue.content: Did your mother not hear you out?

dialogue.origin: いえ、私の携帯で証拠を見せたし
dialogue.content: No, I showed her the proof on my phone.

dialogue.origin: うん、うん
dialogue.content: Right, right.

dialogue.origin: 泣いて、説明したので、わかってくれました
dialogue.content: I cried while I explained everything, so she understood.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね！
dialogue.content: I’m glad to hear that!

dialogue.origin: 分かってもらえたのはよかった…
dialogue.content: It’s good that she understood you...

dialogue.origin: けれど、先生が信じてくれなかった？
dialogue.content: But your teacher still didn’t believe you?

dialogue.origin: 仕返しされてるかもしれないと思うと、
dialogue.content: When I think it might be someone getting back at me,

dialogue.origin: すごく腹が立って、
dialogue.content: it makes me so angry.

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: なるほど…それは、悪口を書いた相手から？
dialogue.content: I see... Do you think it’s from the person you wrote about before?

dialogue.origin: 誰が言ってきたのかはわかりません
dialogue.content: I don’t know who reported it.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 私、一生怒り続ける
dialogue.content: I’ll be angry forever.

dialogue.origin: うん、仕返しされたように感じて嫌だったんですよね、、
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, you felt like someone was getting revenge on you, and that was upsetting, wasn't it?

dialogue.origin: ていうか、証拠もないのに、なぜ、私？
dialogue.content: I mean, why me when there’s no evidence?

dialogue.origin: いきなり疑われたら、なんで？って起こりたくもなりますよね。。
dialogue.content: Being suddenly suspected like that would make anyone angry and wonder "why?", wouldn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうしたら、
dialogue.content: In that case,

dialogue.origin: 一度ここまでのお話を整理してもいいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: may I summarize what I’ve heard so far?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: かおりさんは、一度悪口を書き込んでしまったけれど、親や先生と相談して、LINEも削除して、解決策を作って、ちゃんとそれをやりましたよね。
dialogue.content: So Kaori, you wrote some mean things once, but you talked it over with your parents and teacher, deleted the LINE messages, came up with a solution, and followed through with it, right?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: その後、別の誰かが悪口をまた書いたようで、別の中学の方から通報が入った。証拠もないのに、あなたが疑われた。お母さんには納得してもらえたけれど、先生には「またお前だろ！」と信じてもらえない…。
dialogue.content: After that, it seems someone else wrote more mean things, and a report came in from the other school. With no proof, you were suspected. Your mother was convinced of your innocence, but your teacher doesn't believe you, thinking, "It must be you again!"... Is my understanding correct so far?

dialogue.origin: ここまで、私の理解はあっていますか？
dialogue.content: Is my understanding correct so far?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: よかった。辛かったのに、話してくれてありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: I’m glad. Thank you for talking about this even though it’s been hard.

dialogue.origin: 少しでもかおりさんが嫌な気持ちでなくなるように、一緒に方法を考えましょう。
dialogue.content: Let's think of a way together to help you feel even a little bit better.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: 今回、本当にいろいろあって大変だったよね…。その中で、先生や親にはどうしてほしかったか、どうされたら、怒らずに済んだか。
dialogue.content: You've really been through a lot this time... In all of this, what did you wish your teacher and parents had done? What could they have done so that you wouldn't have felt so angry?

dialogue.origin: 改めて、かおりさんの言葉で話すことはできますか…？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me again, in your own words...?

dialogue.origin: 怒らずにすんだ、というのは
dialogue.content: When I say "wouldn't have felt so angry,"

dialogue.origin: 先生や親ではなく、かおりさん自身が怒らずに済むには、周りにどうして欲しかったか、ということです。
dialogue.content: I mean what you wish others had done so that you, Kaori, wouldn't have had to feel this anger.

dialogue.origin: 相手のLINEのシュクショがあれば、ちゃんと証拠をもらって確認してくれれば、私じゃないことがわかるのに、してくれない
dialogue.content: If they had a screenshot of the other person's LINE, they should have gotten the proof and checked it properly. Then they would've known it wasn't me, but they didn't.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、そうですよね、
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, that's right,

dialogue.origin: あなたじゃない可能性を、ちゃんと考えて欲しかったですよね。
dialogue.content: you just wanted them to properly consider the possibility that it wasn't you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 私じゃないし
dialogue.content: It wasn't me.

dialogue.origin: そう、あなたじゃない。私は、今お話を聞いただけだけど
dialogue.content: Right, it wasn't you. I've only just heard your side of the story, but

dialogue.origin: かおりさんの想いが伝わってきています。あなたじゃないと、私も心から信じています。
dialogue.content: I can feel how strongly you feel about this. I truly believe it wasn't you.

dialogue.origin: それに今回…かおりさんも反省してるんですもんね。
dialogue.content: Besides... you've reflected on what you did, haven't you, Kaori?

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 傷つけるのはやっぱり良くないと思いました
dialogue.content: I realized that hurting others really isn’t okay.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。それを知ることができたんですね
dialogue.content: I see. So that's something you were able to learn.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: それが分かったからこそ、自分が傷つけられるのも納得いきませんよね。。
dialogue.content: And because you understand that, it's even more unacceptable to be hurt yourself, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうです
dialogue.content: That’s right.

dialogue.origin: いやでしたよね。それでも、かおりさんは
dialogue.content: It must have been awful. And yet, Kaori,

dialogue.origin: イライラしたからといって誰かに八つ当たりするって方法もあったかもしれないのに、こうやってLINEで誰かに相談できましたよね
dialogue.content: even though you were frustrated, you could have taken it out on someone else, but instead you reached out to talk to someone on LINE like this.

dialogue.origin: それは、とても大人な対応だと思います。
dialogue.content: I think that’s a very mature way to handle it.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですか
dialogue.content: Really?

dialogue.origin: かおりさん自身は、どう思いますか？
dialogue.content: What do you think, Kaori?

dialogue.origin: 時々、SNS相談って言うのに、来ていたから、話そうと思ったんです
dialogue.content: I've used these SNS counseling services before, so I thought I'd talk about it.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね、これが初めてではなかった？
dialogue.content: I see—so this isn’t your first time?

dialogue.origin: 困ったりした時、とか
dialogue.content: When I'm having trouble, or something like that.

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: だから、イライラしてるって、どうしたらいいかって、聞きたかった
dialogue.content: So, I wanted to ask what I should do about being so frustrated.

dialogue.origin: 先生が信じてくれないのは悔しい
dialogue.content: It’s so frustrating that my teacher doesn’t believe me.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね、改めて、相談してくれてありがとう。悔しい。悔しいですよね。
dialogue.content: I see. Thank you again for coming to talk to me. It's frustrating. It really is, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 先生が信じてくれなかった…これ、とても嫌だったと思います
dialogue.content: Your teacher not believing you—that must have felt really awful.

dialogue.origin: どんなお話をしたのか…もう少し詳しく聞くことはできますか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me a little more about the conversation you had?

dialogue.origin: もう少しって？
dialogue.content: What do you mean by “a bit more”?

dialogue.origin: 先生に言われた後に、かおりさんからどんな話をしたのか…とか
dialogue.content: Like, what did you say to the teacher after they said that to you?

dialogue.origin: 先生とどうお話をしたのか、知りたいです。
dialogue.content: I'd like to know how the conversation with your teacher went.

dialogue.origin: それは私じゃありません、削除もすでにしています、証拠があるんですか？
dialogue.content: I said, "It wasn't me. I already deleted everything. Do you have any proof?"

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: その後、家に電話してきたから、全然信じてないんだなと思った
dialogue.content: After that, they called my house, so I realized they didn't believe me at all.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、よくわかりました、そうか、電話してきたのはその後ですね。一度ちゃんと伝えたのに親に連絡を入れてきたから、信じてもらえないと思った。
dialogue.content: I see, that makes perfect sense. So the phone call came after that. Even though you clearly told them, they still contacted your parents, which made you feel they didn't believe you.

dialogue.origin: ごめんね、さっきはちゃんと聞けていませんでした。
dialogue.content: I'm sorry, I didn't catch that properly before.

dialogue.origin: 初めから、信じてる言い方じゃなかったし
dialogue.content: From the very beginning, the way they spoke, it wasn't like they believed me.

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 最初から疑われたままだったんですね…
dialogue.content: So you felt suspected from the beginning...

dialogue.origin: たぶん
dialogue.content: Probably.

dialogue.origin: その先生とは、これからも学校で顔を合わせるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Will you have to keep seeing that teacher at school?

dialogue.origin: 担任です
dialogue.content: They’re my homeroom teacher.

dialogue.origin: なるほど…信じてもらえないと感じているまま、毎日顔を合わせるの、いやですよね。。
dialogue.content: I see... It must be hard to have to see them every day while feeling like they don't believe you.

dialogue.origin: このままじゃずっと怒り続ける
dialogue.content: If this keeps up, I’ll stay angry forever.

dialogue.origin: だよね。ずっと怒ったままですよね。きっとどんな人でもそうなると思う。。
dialogue.content: Right. You'd stay angry forever. I think anyone would feel that way.

dialogue.origin: でも、かおりさんはその怒りをなくすことができたら、と考えているんですよね
dialogue.content: But you're thinking you'd like to be able to let go of that anger, right?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: わかりました。一つ、「もしも」の話をしていいですか？
dialogue.content: I understand. Can I ask you a "what if" question?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: もし、先生に少しでも謝ってもらえたら。もし、反省している自分を少しでも信じてくれたら。
dialogue.content: What if the teacher apologized, even just a little? What if they believed, even just a little, that you have reflected on your actions?

dialogue.origin: かおりさんの怒りは、今よりも少なくなりそうですか？
dialogue.content: Do you think your anger would lessen, compared to how you feel now?

dialogue.origin: 本当のことが分かって、謝ってもらえるんなら
dialogue.content: If they understood the truth and apologized,

dialogue.origin: うん、そうだよね。
dialogue.content: Mm, that makes sense.

dialogue.origin: 今回…かおりさんはすごく大きなことを学んだよね。それは、傷つけられた側の気持ち。
dialogue.content: This time, you learned something really significant: how it feels to be on the side that gets hurt.

dialogue.origin: 自分が傷つけた相手に対して「悪かった」と思えた。だからこそ、それを先生にされて悔しかった。
dialogue.content: You were able to feel that what you did to the other person was wrong. That's precisely why it was so frustrating when your teacher did it to you.

dialogue.origin: 今回の一件で、ただ怒られたからLINEを消しただけじゃない。傷つけられる側の気持ちが分かったからこそ、今傷つけられている気持ちがして辛い。
dialogue.content: With this incident, you didn't just delete the LINE messages because you were told to. You're feeling hurt now because you truly understand what it feels like to be on the receiving end.

dialogue.origin: それを、先生に伝えるのはどうだろう？
dialogue.content: What about telling that to your teacher?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 泣いちゃうかもしれない
dialogue.content: I might start crying.

dialogue.origin: うん、そうだよね。。勇気がいるよね。
dialogue.content: Yes, I can see that. It takes a lot of courage.

dialogue.origin: もしも、できたら、手紙を用意していくのはどうだろう？
dialogue.content: If you think you can, what about preparing a letter beforehand?

dialogue.origin: 手紙を書くの？
dialogue.content: Write a letter?

dialogue.origin: 泣いていると話せないかもしれない。けれど、手紙を渡せば、泣いてしまっても、伝えられるかもしれないよ。どうかな？
dialogue.content: It might be hard to talk if you're crying. But if you give them a letter, you might still be able to get your feelings across, even if you cry. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 話をしたい、と先生を呼んで、できるだけ自分の言葉で伝えられないか試してみる。
dialogue.content: You could ask to speak with the teacher, and try to explain in your own words as much as you can.

dialogue.origin: もし、泣いちゃいそうになったら、用意しておいた手紙を渡す。
dialogue.content: If you start to feel like you might cry, you can hand over the letter you prepared.

dialogue.origin: そっか、先に渡すんじゃなく
dialogue.content: I see, so not give it to them right away.

dialogue.origin: 親は信じてくれたから、話してみます
dialogue.content: My parents believed me, so I’ll try talking to the teacher.

dialogue.origin: うん、手紙を渡すだけだとちょっと無愛想に思われるかもしれないけど
dialogue.content: Yes, just handing over a letter might seem a little blunt,

dialogue.origin: 顔を見せて渡すと、伝わりかたが違うかもしれませんよね…！
dialogue.content: but handing it to them in person might make a different impression...!

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Right.

dialogue.origin: これは、私が感じたことなんだけど…。話してもいいですか？
dialogue.content: This is just something I felt... Is it okay if I share it?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 中学3年生の時期、みんなが大人に変わっていくタイミングだけど
dialogue.content: The third year of middle school is a time when everyone is starting to become an adult,

dialogue.origin: きっと、かおりさんは周りの子たちよりも１歩早く大人になったんだと思うんです。
dialogue.content: and I think you, Kaori, have taken a step toward adulthood a little earlier than the others around you.

dialogue.origin: そうかなa
dialogue.content: You think so?

dialogue.origin: 初めの方でも言ったけど、イライラしても他の誰かに当たらずに、こうやってどうしたらイライラを解消できるか、相談してくれた。
dialogue.content: As I said at the beginning, even when you were frustrated, instead of taking it out on someone else, you reached out for advice on how to deal with that frustration.

dialogue.origin: 今話してみて、イライラしてますか？
dialogue.content: Now that we've talked, are you still feeling frustrated?

dialogue.origin: 今は、落ち着いてきました
dialogue.content: I’m starting to feel calmer now.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね！よかったです。
dialogue.content: I see! I’m glad to hear that.

dialogue.origin: …ほら、あなたは、自分のイライラをこうやって誰かに話すことで、ちゃんと落ち着かせられてる。
dialogue.content: ...See? You're able to calm your own frustration by talking about it with someone.

dialogue.origin: 今日、私は手紙を渡すのを提案しただけだよ。イライラの解消方法は、話してません…。それでも落ち着いてきたのは
dialogue.content: All I did today was suggest giving them a letter. I didn't tell you how to resolve your frustration... The reason you've calmed down is

dialogue.origin: 先生と話さなきゃと思うと、少し、興奮（笑）
dialogue.content: When I think about having to talk to my teacher, I get a little worked up (laughs).

dialogue.origin: そうだね笑今みたいに落ち着けてきたのはさ、あなたに、かおりさん自身にイライラを解消する力があるからだと思うんだけど
dialogue.content: Right (laughs). The reason you've been able to calm down like this is, I think, because you, Kaori, have the power within you to resolve your own frustration.

dialogue.origin: どう思いますか？
dialogue.content: What do you think?

dialogue.origin: よくわからないです
dialogue.content: I’m not really sure.

dialogue.origin: そうだよね。よくわからないよね。
dialogue.content: Right. It's hard to be sure.

dialogue.origin: でも、こうやって誰かに相談しても、やっぱりイライラしたままの子もいるよ。
dialogue.content: But you know, some people are still frustrated even after talking to someone like this.

dialogue.origin: そうなのかなぁ
dialogue.content: I guess so.

dialogue.origin: 比較するものではないかもしれないけど…あなたは、自分をしっかり冷静に考えられる大人に近づいていってると、私は思うなぁ。
dialogue.content: It might not be something to compare, but... I think you are growing into an adult who can think about things calmly and clearly.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: すみません、今のは相談員というより、私が思ったことです！笑
dialogue.content: Sorry, that was just my personal thought, not me as a counselor! (laughs)

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: No, thank you.

dialogue.origin: 先生に手紙、渡せそう？
dialogue.content: Do you think you'll be able to give the letter to your teacher?

dialogue.origin: はい、書きながら、言いたいこと、整理できそうな気がしてきています
dialogue.content: Yes, I feel like I'll be able to organize my thoughts and what I want to say as I write it.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね！良かったです。
dialogue.content: I see! That's wonderful.

dialogue.origin: 今日はそろそろ時間だから、これで一旦終了にしたいと思いますが…。今日は、かおりさんに何かお役に立てましたか？
dialogue.content: It's about time for us to finish for today. Was I able to help you in any way today, Kaori?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 良かったです。私もあなたの話を聞けて良かった！
dialogue.content: I'm so glad. It was good for me to hear your story, too!

dialogue.origin: やってみます！
dialogue.content: I’ll give it a try!

dialogue.origin: ここには、いつでも相談に来てくださいね。先生がどんな反応をするか、私も楽しみです！！
dialogue.content: Please feel free to come back and talk anytime. I'm looking forward to hearing how your teacher reacts!

dialogue.origin: それでは、そろそろ終了とさせていただきますね。
dialogue.content: Alright then, we'll end the session here.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 失礼します
dialogue.content: Goodbye.

dialogue.origin: 寒いので、お体に気をつけてね。
dialogue.content: It’s cold out, so please take care of yourself.

dialogue.origin: 相談員さんも、ね！
dialogue.content: You too, counselor!

dialogue.origin: ありがとう！笑私も頑張りますね。
dialogue.content: Thank you! (laughs) I’ll do my best, too.

dialogue.origin: それでは、失礼します。
dialogue.content: Alright then, goodbye.

topic.sub: 先生との信頼関係の問題
